function.arguments:
{"script":"while read -r link; do
    if [ -L "$link" ]; then
        target=$(readlink -f "$link")
        if [ -f "$target" ]; then
            echo "$target"
        elif [ ! -e "$target" ]; then
            echo "Unresolved link: $link -> $target" >> temp_var_inventory/errors.log
        fi
    fi
done < temp_var_inventory/l_only.txt > temp_var_inventory/l_targets.txt

cat temp_var_inventory/f_only.txt temp_var_inventory/l_targets.txt | sort -u > temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt
wc -l temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt
"}
